title: I made a tiny dungeon crawler with Codex where enemies are ammunition
author: RecordingTechnical86
selftext:
This is KICK.EXE, a small turn-based browser game where you kick enemies into barrels, walls, and each other. 



I used Codex for the implementation, including the combat logic, interface, procedural floors, tests, and audio. My role was setting the direction, reviewing the results, and asking for changes when something felt wrong.



Two revisions made a big difference. The graphics initially went toward pixel art, but I wanted simple marks that felt closer to ASCII, so we moved to minimal outlines. The tutorial also used to stop you after the first explosion and ask you to click through an explanation. Now you can keep moving while the hints advance as you play.



That was the interesting part of the process for me: getting something working wasn't the same as getting it comfortable to play. The final build has three floors, upgrades, and a two-phase boss. It's free to play on a desktop or laptop with a keyboard.



Play: [https://rechotech.itch.io/kickexe](https://rechotech.itch.io/kickexe)



I'd love feedback on the game!
